name: Chocolate Shake
description: A rich and creamy chocolate milkshake, a Pakistani favorite.
instructions: Blend milk, cocoa powder, sugar, and ice cream until smooth.
Add ice cubes, serve chilled.

name: Banana Shake
description: A sweet and creamy banana milkshake.
instructions: Blend bananas, milk, sugar, and ice cream.
Add ice, serve cold.

name: Pista Shake
instructions: Blend milk, pistachio paste, sugar, and ice cream.
Add ice, serve chilled.

name: Mango Shake
description: A tropical mango milkshake with a creamy texture.
instructions: Blend mango puree, milk, sugar, and ice cream.
Add ice, serve cold.

name: Strawberry Shake
instructions: Blend strawberries, milk, sugar, and ice cream.
Add ice, serve chilled.

name: Date Shake
description: A healthy shake with dates and nuts.
instructions: Soak dates, blend with milk, almonds, and honey.
Add ice, serve cold.

name: Chikoo Shake
description: A sweet and creamy sapodilla shake.
instructions: Peel and blend chikoos with milk and sugar.
Add ice cream and ice, serve chilled.

name: Mixed Nut Shake
description: A protein-rich shake with mixed nuts.
instructions: Blend milk, nuts, and sugar until smooth.
Add ice, serve cold.

name: Caramel Shake
instructions: Blend milk, caramel syrup, and ice cream.
Add ice, serve chilled.

name: Rose Shake
description: A fragrant shake with rose syrup.
instructions: Blend milk, rose syrup, and ice cream.
Add ice, garnish with pistachios, serve cold.
